captures.page: /bonus-bet — desktop shell (drawer + rail hidden by media query)
/bonus-bet — desktop shell (drawer + rail hidden by media query)

inspection.reviewer: Claude rendered-pixel review via local Chromium CDP + image inspection against vite preview at 127.0.0.1:4173
findings: Desktop dark and light captures confirm the mobile bottom rail and drawer overlay are hidden by the (min-width: 769px) media query — the shell, header, and horizontal tab strip render unchanged from prior visual baselines.

Mobile dark and light captures show the drawer sub-nav opened over the Convert group at 390×844: the drag handle, Convert section header with SVG icon, and the five sub-items (Bonus Bet, Profit Boost, First Bet, Deposit Match, Insurance) render in a scrollable column, with Bonus Bet marked active via the green left border and status dot.

The fixed bottom rail is visible under the drawer in the mobile captures with all six SVG icons (Home, Convert, Calc, Track, Live, Learn) and the active Convert icon glowing green — matching the CANON-041 spec.
Dark theme uses the KD palette gradient (deep navy shell, green accent). Light theme uses the KL palette (soft slate shell, deeper green accent) — no black-on-black or light-on-white failures.

Drawer is a role=dialog with aria-modal, focus is trapped inside the sheet, and browser Back / Escape both dismiss (verified in-browser via the readiness poll and drawer state assertion in the capture script).
fixesApplied: Replaced text-label MobileBottomNav with a real SVG icon set (Home / Convert / Calc / Track / Live / Learn) and an active-tab glow indicator.
Added a 100dvh scrollable drawer sub-nav that opens on tap-active-tab, listing every sub-item in the group with PRO badges and active-item marker.
Made the drawer resilient to viewport crossing the mobile breakpoint (matchMedia listener closes on desktop; CSS also hides the backdrop).
Added a browser-history entry on open so Android/browser Back dismisses the drawer.
Added focus trap: focus moves into the sheet on open, Tab cycles within, focus restores to the triggering rail button on close.
